ges.bew.ergebnis.dialog: The government invites the {art} to talks.
ges.bew.ergebnis.polizei: The police break up the rallies of the {art}.
ges.bew.ergebnis.verbot: The governor bans all rallies of the {art}.
ges.bew.ergebnis.zugestaendnis: The government meets the {art} halfway and fulfils part of the demands.
ges.bew.folge.groesse_stark_kurz: disappears from the streets, for now
ges.bew.keine: Calm on the streets: no ongoing movement.
ges.bew.massen.text: Hundreds of thousands take to the streets in {orte}. Markets, tourists and foreign capitals are watching.
ges.bew.opfer: There are injuries and one death; the images go around the world.
ges.bew.warn.text: Discontent is forming in {orte}: {art}. It is still small; how the government answers now decides whether it becomes a mass movement.
ges.bew.warn.warum: Pressure becomes a movement when nobody answers.
ges.kom.abziehen_ergebnis: The trustee in {stadt} is withdrawn; the elected council takes over again.
ges.kom.ergebnis: Local elections: the bloc holds {nachher} of 81 town halls (before {vorher}), wins {gewonnen} and loses {verloren}.
ges.kom.grund.eigenes: The town hall belongs to your own bloc.
ges.kom.grund.schon: There is already a trustee there.
ges.kom.stand: The bloc holds {lager} of 81 town halls. Next local election: {naechste}.
ges.kom.verwalter_ergebnis: A trustee takes over the town hall of {stadt}; the {partei} speaks of a coup against the voters' will.
ges.kom.verwalter_hinweis: A trustee costs {k} capital and gives control of the city; it costs standing, feeds local protest and is paid for at the next election.
ges.kom.warum: Voting is local: trust in the government in each province, the incumbency bonus and memories of trustees decide.
ges.kz.groll.text: Average pent-up resentment of Kurds, Alevis, women, refugees and the diaspora.
ges.kz.opposition.text: Mobilisation and credibility of the leading opposition party.
ges.kz.polarisierung.text: How deeply the country is divided; feeds protests, violence and camp thinking.
ges.kz.protest.text: How strongly discontent pushes onto the streets.
ges.kz.rathaeuser.text: Provincial capitals whose mayor belongs to the governing bloc.
ges.kz.repression.text: Harsh interventions are remembered and fuel unrest later; fades only slowly.
ges.milieus.text: Their mood follows policy, their resentment is memory: it grows while things go badly and does not vanish with one good month.
ges.opp.ausschuss_verweigert: The inquiry committee was not allowed. The {partei} speaks of a cover-up.
ges.opp.ergebnis.ausschuss_zulassen: The bloc allows the inquiry committee. The opposition loses an issue, the government gains credibility.
ges.opp.ergebnis.ermittlung: Prosecutors investigate the leadership of the {partei}. The party speaks of political justice; its supporters close ranks.
ges.opp.ergebnis.gespraech: The president receives the leadership of the {partei}. The tone calms; in the bloc people say he is making the rival big.
ges.opp.ergebnis.immunitaet: Parliament lifts the immunity of leading {partei} deputies. Brussels and the markets react.
ges.opp.ergebnis.verbot: The chief prosecutor applies to ban the {partei}. The Constitutional Court will rule in {tage} days.
ges.opp.folge.gericht: The Constitutional Court rules in 180 days; uncertain, depending on its independence
ges.opp.folge.rueckschlag: If it fails, the opposition is strengthened
ges.opp.keine_zuege: The opposition has not acted yet.
ges.opp.log_warum: The opposition acts on its own: the {partei} probes the government's weaknesses.
ges.opp.marke.ausschuss: Demands an inquiry committee ({tage} days left)
ges.opp.verbot.abgewiesen.text: The Constitutional Court rejects the ban on the {partei}. The government looks defeated, the opposition triumphs.
ges.opp.verbot.verboten.text: The Constitutional Court bans the {partei}. Its deputies found a successor party; anger grows on the streets and criticism abroad.
ges.opp.ziel: Under current conditions its strength tends towards {ziel}.
ges.opp.zug.anfrage.text: The {partei} floods the ministries with questions and keeps its issues in the headlines.
ges.opp.zug.ausschuss.text: The {partei} demands an inquiry into contracts and assets. Allow it within {tage} days or pay with distrust.
ges.opp.zug.boykott.text: The {partei} stays away from sessions. A parliament without opposition costs legitimacy at home and abroad.
ges.opp.zug.buendnis.text: The {partei} forms an alliance with {mit}. The opposition appears more united.
ges.opp.zug.grossdemo.text: The {partei} calls for mass rallies in Istanbul, Ankara and Izmir. A rally can become a movement.
ges.opp.zug.kampagne.text: The {partei} marches through the cities with shopping baskets: who pays for the rising prices?
ges.zweck: Who takes to the streets, who opposes and who runs the cities: a society with memory. Resentment, martyrs and repression linger for months.
